A bill for an act relating to legacy; appropriating money for river watch program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; RIVER WATCH PROGRAM. +]

[+$150,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $150,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the clean water fund to the commissioner of the Pollution Control Agency for grants to Friends of the Minnesota Valley to enhance and expand the existing water-quality and watershed-monitoring river watch activities in schools in the Minnesota River basin watershed and, in cooperation with Clean River Partners, to provide a river watch program in the Cannon River basin watershed. By February 15, 2027, Friends of the Minnesota Valley must provide a report to the commissioner and the legislative committees and divisions with jurisdiction over environment and natural resources finance and policy and the clean water fund on the expenditure of this appropriation. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to legacy; appropriating money for river watch program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; RIVER WATCH PROGRAM.

$150,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $150,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the clean water fund to the commissioner of the Pollution Control Agency for grants to Friends of the Minnesota Valley to enhance and expand the existing water-quality and watershed-monitoring river watch activities in schools in the Minnesota River basin watershed and, in cooperation with Clean River Partners, to provide a river watch program in the Cannon River basin watershed. By February 15, 2027, Friends of the Minnesota Valley must provide a report to the commissioner and the legislative committees and divisions with jurisdiction over environment and natural resources finance and policy and the clean water fund on the expenditure of this appropriation.
additions: $150,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $150,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the clean water fund to the commissioner of the Pollution Control Agency for grants to Friends of the Minnesota Valley to enhance and expand the existing water-quality and watershed-monitoring river watch activities in schools in the Minnesota River basin watershed and, in cooperation with Clean River Partners, to provide a river watch program in the Cannon River basin watershed. By February 15, 2027, Friends of the Minnesota Valley must provide a report to the commissioner and the legislative committees and divisions with jurisdiction over environment and natural resources finance and policy and the clean water fund on the expenditure of this appropriation.
